I doubt it is too easily implemented, but any chance we can make it so you
can't be traitor 4 or 5 times in a row? How Rand is Rand() anyway?

At the very least, it ought to be easy to store the key of the previous traitor in a
text file and not let him be traitor again. Same could go for Syndicate in Nuke mode.

This hasn't come up at all since then, I'd guess one of the various updates has fixed
it. Marking as fixed unless it happens again.
